title: BR-019 full-view trace: from the CT crop to a recovered slice pose
claim: The retained BR-019 full-view Terra/high attempt moved from wrong intensity-search poses to a near-reference silhouette candidate and then full-resolution refinement. The saved final transform passes at 0.000477 mm RMS / 0.000744 mm maximum; native re-rendering reproduces the logged 56 differing pixels out of 36,864.
limitations: One successful same-acquisition attempt on one subject; no clinical precision, anatomical-understanding or cross-scan robustness claim.
Selected intermediate matrices and search parameters are reconstructed from rounded logs; their geometric errors are post-hoc diagnostics, not frozen evaluations.
Silhouette matching, bounds and search settings changed within the run; this trace is not a causal ablation.
The volume viewer covers the full solver-visible thoracic crop, not the entire original patient scan.
